audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Incorrect variational constant and false optimized abstract pointwise estimate; Zero-mode reconstruction and generator identities; Transformed initial data omitted in diagonalization proof
limitations: M25-0289-P1 — Incorrect variational constant and false optimized abstract pointwise estimate — Counterevidence: No geometric PDE counterexample follows from the abstract finite-dimensional example; qualitative logarithmic growth and Section6 remain unrefuted.

M25-0289-P2 — Zero-mode reconstruction and generator identities — Counterevidence: Energy ignores constant displacement, and sourceLemma2.8 separately gives correct projected evolution/reconstruction.

M25-0289-P3 — Transformed initial data omitted in diagonalization proof — Counterevidence: This contribution is already within the precise remainder order asserted inProposition2.11; no failure of that conclusion follows.

M25-0289-P4 — A factor one-half is lost in the diagonal damping — Counterevidence: Replacingb byb/2 in the diagonal restoresCorollary2.12; undamped transport remains1. This does not establish failure of the final qualitative PDE theorem.

M25-0289-P5 — Convolution does not preserve the claimed zero set at the stated scale — Counterevidence: CorollaryA.6 is an existence statement and is not itself refuted. The valid approximation estimate also yields a1+O(tomega)transport factor at logarithmic times, so no qualitative theorem counterexample is claimed.

M25-0289-P6 — An operator-valued restatement exchanges supremum and time integration — Counterevidence: The actual vector inequality(6.6), its proof, and its Section6 application have the supremum outside the integral and are not contradicted.

M25-0289-P7 — Appendix semigroup estimate mixes scaled and unscaled time — Counterevidence: The correct unscaled estimate givesexp(ht). Actual Section4 scaled operator ish times the unscaled generator, so the repaired bound is the one needed in(4.13).
